compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns ADJ/GND (GND) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns INPUT (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns VOUT (VOUT) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns VIN (VIN) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns OUTPUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Soldering LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB onto a LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (VOUT vs GND) — direct swap will short power rails.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB is rated to only 15 V rec. (20 V abs max, p.4) vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB at 26 V rec. (26 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 400 mA (p.5) compared to LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB at 800 mA (p.7); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs by 700 mV (LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 1200 mV p.8 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 500 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo at cold/hot corners.
engineering_verdict: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) and LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 5000 µA (p.8) vs 2000 µA (p.5), max output current is 800 mA (p.7) vs 400 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 15 V (p.4) vs 26 V (p.4), typical dropout is 1200 mV (p.8) vs 500 mV (p.5), and ceramic capacitor stability is ESR-constrained vs ESR-constrained. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 61.6 vs 58.3 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
